successors.text: Vengi, "between the Godavari and the Krishna rivers": the doab north of the Krishna (west edge at Vijayawada, south edge the Krishna to its mouth, east edge the delta coast and the Godavari at…

ledger.x: c. 325 (bridge): the Salankayanas hold the whole doab once the Ikshvaku inscriptions stop. "Ikshvaku dynasty, whose last extant inscription is from c. 325 CE, ruled the Krishna-Godavari region in the early 4th century. Their successors, whose rule possibly overlapped with them, included the Salankayanas (c. 300-450)"…

certainty.note: No border is given; the territory is the doab between the Godavari and the Krishna named by the page.
